requirements.general_text: Any one of these: Matriculation/Foundation – with CGPA 2.0 STPM with 2 full passes with min. CGPA of 2.0 Unified Examination Certificate (UEC) with at least 5Bs Recognised Creative Multimedia Diploma or equivalent with a min. CGPA of 2.5 SPM – Pass in Mathematics or equivalent for programmes in Animation and Visual Effects, Games Development, Media Innovation, Sound Design, Video and Film and Virtual Reality. Note: The Faculty may consider students through an internal assessment process such as an interview, an assessment of a portfolio or other tests to ensure effective learning and teaching.
